structured_output.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
All three checks passed on every run (rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections). None used the width-free ratio.
Some robust z values look large: the REGR peak at ±2.7 and the flank-difference position at −3.19 in r02 and r08. They are large only because the batch spread is close to zero. The actual differences are tiny: the REGR peak is within ±0.04 %/h of about 52.9 %/h, the flank-difference position moves 11 µm (410 vs 421 µm), and growth-zone length stays between 674 and 695 µm. The centre REGR peak is at 421 µm in every run.
r07 kept one remedy: the frames were registered on the non-growing tissue before tracking. That remedy does not change the time base, and all checks passed afterwards, which is the normal path.
Since nothing was flagged, there is nothing shared to report about flagged runs. The velocity, strain-rate and curvature profiles all have the same shape across the batch.
